name: project-router
description: Route project work by verified phase, maturity, exposure, and permissions. Includes Aaron's planning, rescoping, continuity, execution, and cleanup skills.

interface.longDescription: One project-lifecycle dispatcher with six companion workflows: projectplan-builder, projectplan-rescope, continuing-alm-work, workbetter, clean-project, and directory-cleanup. Evidence-led maturity assessment, bounded execution, explicit cleanup modes, and preserved approval boundaries. Uses tools already available in the host; no new server or credentials.
defaultPrompt: Use project-router in assess mode. Read the available project context, identify its phase and maturity, and select the next justified workflow. Do not change files.
Use project-router in continue mode for the next ready task in the approved plan. Preserve scope and unrelated work; stop at a verified task boundary or missing approval.
